trailhead.label: Start here — Bus stop Stefansdorfer Straße, Sportzone - Via Santo Stefano, zona sportiva, 9 m from the route

cautions: About 200 m on the Reiperting road at the start and short stretches of village lanes: keep your dog on a short lead there.
One crossing of the Reischacher Straße (SP66) at about km 7.6: cross with care.
The track crosses a ski slope near km 1.2; snow cannons stand by the way.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Start here — Bus stop Stefansdorfer Stra: Parti da qui — Fermata dell'autobus Stefansdorfer Straße, Sportzone - Via Santo Stefano, zona sportiva, a 9 m dal percorso
textIt.About 200 m on the Reiperting road at th: Circa 200 m sulla strada di Reiperting alla partenza e brevi tratti di stradine di paese: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.One crossing of the Reischacher Straße (: Un attraversamento della Via Riscone (SP66) verso il km 7,6: attraversa con attenzione.
La strada attraversa una pista da sci vicino al km 1,2; lungo il percorso ci sono cannoni da neve.
